messages:
mira: Heads-up — we're seeing a few customer reports where org-scoped API keys are being accepted but billed under the project's default. Can we clarify routing + telemetry before we flip the new consent behavior?
kevin: Ugh. Is this the implicit key -> project fallback we discussed last quarter? IIRC the router uses `x-origin-org` header then falls back to `project` claim.
sam: Yep. Current behavior: if org claim missing, we bind to project from API key metadata. That causes billing attribution mismatch when keys were generated at org level but used without org header.
mira: Proposal: introduce a boolean `origin_resolution.path` tag in telemetry that records whether resolution used org header, token-exchange, or fallback-project. That way billing + support can reconcile. Also show it in Console logs for first-party debugging.
kevin: +1 on telemetry tag. Also need to surface a UX nudge in Console when a key is created: "This key will bill to: <detected entity>. If you intend otherwise, enable org-scoped headers or create a project-scoped key." Small copy change.
sam: For rollout we should: 1) emit telemetry only (2 weeks) 2) show Console nudge (opt-in via feature flag) 3) block/require explicit consent for ambiguous keys (opt-out by customers)
mira: Can we log the router decision as an enumerated string: `org_header`, `exchange`, `implicit_project`, `service_account_impersonation`? Keep stable values for dashboards.
kevin: Agree. Also add `auth_path_version` so we know which resolver produced the claim (v1/v2) — helpful when we switch the exchange service.
ops-bot: deploy: auth-router v2.14 -> canary started in us-west-2 (meta:deploy/1771234610) :rocket:
sam: Small config warning — if we surface the nudge in Console, product wants to show the exact billing entity. That requires a fast lookup from key -> canonical org/project. We should avoid extra synchronous RPCs on each request. Cache the mapping in the router for 5m and emit cache-hit/miss telemetry.
mira: Good call. Add telemetry fields: `origin_resolution`, `origin_entity_type` (org/project/service_account), `origin_entity_id`, `cache_status` (hit/miss), `resolver_version`.
kevin: For quotas: when fallback-project is used, quota enforcement should still use the project's limits, but we should emit an alert if a key created at org level is consuming project quota unexpectedly. Maybe a daily aggregator that flags >X% cross-entity usage.
sam: I'll draft the aggregator job. Pseudocode: 
```
for each day:
  for each key:
    if key.created_under_org && usage_billed_to_project:
      ratio = billed_tokens/total_org_tokens
      if ratio > threshold: emit_alert(key, ratio)
```
mira: UX question: Do we retroactively reassign past billing when customers flip the "honor org-scoped" toggle? Product says no — that would be messy. We should surface an estimate of affected spend and recommend a migration plan.
kevin: Right — do not retro-bill. Provide an export CSV with `timestamp, request_id, origin_entity_id, billed_entity_id` for customer ops. That can be produced from telemetry after the 2-week collection window.
sam: One potential gotcha: service account impersonation flows. If `sa:impersonate` returns a project claim, router should tell telemetry the full chain: `incoming_api_key -> sa_impersonation -> final_claim`. We can log `auth_chain` as a short delimited string. Keep it bounded (max 3 hops).
mira: Yes — truncate and mark as `truncated` if >3. Also mark when consent was required and whether user granted explicit consent.
kevin: Security note: telemetry must never include raw secret or key material. Only key id and stable handles. Confirm with security review.
mira: I'll file a quick security PR.
ops-bot: note: security-review requested by mira (sec-triage/1771234620)
sam: Timeline suggestion: start telemetry capture tomorrow, run for 14 days, generate daily dashboards (team: eng-platform, support, billing), then enable Console nudge behind feat flag, then 2-week opt-in canary with 10% orgs.
mira: Sounds good. I'll create a project board with tasks: telemetry impl, router cache, aggregator job, console copy, export CSV, security sign-off.
kevin: One last thing — metrics names: prefer `auth.origin_resolution`, `auth.origin_entity`, `auth.resolver_version`, `auth.cache_status`. Keep dot notation for Prometheus-friendly exporters.
sam: I'll wire those names into the router PR.
mira: Thanks everyone. If we hit weird edge-cases during canary, call an immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
kevin: Adding follow-up: check rate-limit token accounting for fallback path (sometimes we double-count when exchange in middle). I'll open issue after lunch.
ops-bot: reminder: standup tomorrow 10:15am PT — agenda: auth rollout check-in
